links.outcome: ChatGPT-4o accuracy identifying and describing dermatologic DDIs versus established references
links.effect: Identified all 43 interactions; accurately described interaction effects in 42 cases, with one misdescription.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o successfully identified all evaluated interactions. It accurately described the interaction effects in 42 cases, with only one example of misdescription.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4o's baseline accuracy in identifying dermatological drug-drug interactions compared against reference standards; does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
